market_view: VIX fell 17% to 17.1 after a volatile week; chips and miners bounced sharply on the day, oil is still whipsawing. A relief rally, not a cause.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -9% over 5 days, +22% over 20 days, with no OPEC+ or XOM headline. The only energy headline is a Berkshire/Chevron stake article, which is not a catalyst. XOM was flat on the day.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.6% and NEM +4.8% in a day is already priced in. No Fed, dollar or NEM headline. Gold is still 23% below its high and the 10-year yield is high.

chips.reasoning: Nvidia's $2B Nebius investment (Motley Fool) is a minor, already-known item. The Chinese DUV article is opinion. The sector bounced 6.9% in a day after a 13% 20-day drop, which is a mood move, not a catalyst.

pharma.reasoning: LLY fell 4.6% with the health care ETF and no LLY headline. Novo's ZEUS failure (GlobeNewswire) is a different company and trial. The class-action items are noise.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper +2.7% and FCX +5.8% in a day, with no supply or China headline. A driver move that has already happened is priced in.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific headline: OPEC+ or supply shock, Fed or dollar shift, chip export rule or guidance raise, LLY trial or regulator news, copper mine outage.

handoff.what_changed: Three days since the last note (07-28). VIX fell 17% to 17.1, and chips, miners and copper names bounced sharply (semiconductor ETF +6.9%, NEM +4.8%, FCX +5.8%) while LLY fell 4.6%. Headlines again held no leader-specific catalyst.

oil_gas.why: WTI whipsaw has no named cause and there is no XOM or OPEC+ headline.

gold_miners.why: Gold and NEM bounce has no Fed, dollar or NEM catalyst.

chips.why: Sector rebound after a sell-off has no explaining headline; the Nvidia-Nebius stake is minor.

pharma.why: LLY drop has no LLY news; the Novo trial failure is a different company.

copper_uranium.why: FCX and copper rise has no supply or demand headline.
